capture.source: X11 xterm attached to disposable OpenCode host

observations: Frozen install, build, and packed-plugin smoke passed at sourceHead; the treatment host separately loaded the explicit simulation seam from the same source head.
The real TUI /flow-auto invocation reached a delayed simulated Jev request. A digest of its exact outgoing packet was saved in the host private artifact directory.
The Jev request claim preceded the TUI /flow-auto stop by less than the 9000 ms simulated reply delay.
Stop was visible in the TUI; after the delayed reply window the blocked Flow session bytes matched the pre-run snapshot and no reset tool call appeared in the host trace.
limits: The provider reply and manager route were simulated; this is transport/stop evidence, not Jev decision-quality evidence.
Packed-plugin smoke and the simulated treatment host are distinct launches; the treatment host uses an eval-only bundle and its exact digest is recorded.
